content.title: About
content.content: Fat‑free coffee creamer powder is designed to enhance the flavor and texture of coffee. It dissolves in hot or cold beverages, giving them a creamy smoothness without adding fat calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Powdered fat‑free creamer is commonly used in office coffee machines for quick drink preparation.
The formula usually contains skim milk solids, emulsifiers and flavorings, which create a stable foam.
Lack of fat makes the product suitable for low‑calorie diets.
Some versions are fortified with B‑vitamins and calcium.
The powder has a long shelf life when kept dry.

items.title: Reduced calorie intake
items.content: Absence of fat allows you to lower the energy content of coffee without sacrificing taste.

items.title: Calcium enrichment
items.content: Skim milk solids provide an additional source of calcium, beneficial for bone health.

items.title: Convenient use
items.content: The powder dissolves quickly, saving time when preparing drinks.

items.title: Supports low‑fat eating patterns
items.content: Ideal for people monitoring fat consumption or following low‑fat diets.

items.title: Flavor stability
items.content: Emulsifiers keep the taste consistent even after prolonged storage.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Contains skim milk solids, which may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Artificial flavorings
items.content: Some variants include synthetic flavorings that may not be preferred by all consumers.

items.title: Excess additives
items.content: Overuse could lead to excessive intake of emulsifiers and stabilizers.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add 1‑2 teaspoons of powder to hot or cold coffee and stir until fully dissolved. It works well in lattes, cappuccinos, mochas, and even cold brew drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Moisture can cause the powder to clump and lose its solubility.
